paraphrase: Spurned by the Lord, the heroine declares she will ride the maṭal — the palmyra-stem horse of the jilted lover — through the streets, proclaiming his cruelty, though Tamil custom forbids a woman to do so.
speaker: Tirumaṅkai Āḻvār as Parakāla-nāyakī
